comparison.join: family + history feature count + warm phase
comparison.parity: all candidate warm edit samples matched fresh adapter with checkpointing disabled
limitations: Runs shared a host with unrelated native jobs; wall-time deltas are load-sensitive observations, not guarantees or causal attribution.
Five-sample nearest-rank p95 is the maximum observation, not a stable tail estimate.
Adapter timings exclude worker messaging, React scheduling, mesh projection, and viewport rendering.

Baseline source is immutable 06941214; candidate checkout HEAD is b90a7c3b and contains adapter source ae75a23c plus other committed frontend changes. Adapter-source SHA-256 separately identifies the measured adapter files.
Cold phase is adapter/history cold after WASM module loading; it excludes WASM download, compilation, and instantiation.
